T: One night to save the restaurant.
D: Two Italian brothers bet everything on one huge dinner to save their struggling restaurant.
P: Bring out the timpano when the dinner party is still waiting on Louis Prima.
S: Primo's kitchen, every grain treated with respect
Chilled saffron risotto rolled around mozzarella and peas, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold.
red, white and green, the tricolore from the big night
One base risotto split three ways: tomato and basil, parmesan and butter, and pea and mint purée. Serve side by side in one shallow bowl.
the opening course of the big night
Marinated eggplant, peeled roast capsicum, artichoke hearts, olives and thick-cut provolone, with rocket dressed in lemon and oil and warm bread to mop up.
M: the giant baked pasta drum, sliced at the table

Line a buttered dome with thin pasta dough. Layer ziti in ragù with salami, boiled egg, provolone and tiny meatballs, fold the dough over, bake at 180C for 1 hour, rest 30 minutes, turn out and cut like a cake.
the main event, or pork belly if your oven is small
Score pork belly skin, dry overnight in the fridge, rub with salt and fennel seed. Roast at 160C for 2.5 hours, then blast at 240C until it crackles.
W: a sweet finish after the timpano
Heat 500ml cream, 100ml milk, 80g sugar and a split vanilla pod, bloom 2 gelatine leaves, whisk in, pour into moulds, set 6 hours. Turn out with berries.
K: a little grappa, to make you feel better

Short, strong espresso corrected with a splash of grappa, a little sugar stirred through and an almond biscuit on the saucer. Make 4 short espressos with 18g of finely ground coffee each, or brew 200ml very strong stovetop coffee. Pour into 4 small cups. Stir 1 tsp caster sugar into each cup, then add 20ml grappa. Serve each on a saucer with an amaretti biscuit, the way you would finish a long night in the kitchen.

flavour.sign: The Jersey Shore. 1950s. One night only.

note.text: Tonight the timpano comes out of the oven whole or not at all. Primo says nobody orders spaghetti on the side, and he's right.

dishes.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; peel and clean the seafood and chop the onion, garlic and parsley up to 6 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel the prawns, scrub and debeard the mussels, dice the onion, chop the garlic and chop the parsley.
Warm the fish stock in a saucepan. Soften the onion and garlic in the olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the carnaroli rice and toast for 2 minutes, then pour in the white wine and stir until it is absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16 minutes until the rice is nearly tender.
Stir in the prawns, squid rings and mussels, cover and cook for 4 minutes until the mussels open. Throw out any that stay shut.
Take off the heat and stir through the butter, the parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve straight away, no cheese.

veg.n: Lemon and parsley risotto with king oyster mushrooms (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; slice the mushrooms, dice the zucchini and onion and chop the garlic and parsley up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms into coins, dice the zucchini, dice the onion, chop the garlic and chop the parsley.
Sear the mushrooms in 2 tbsp of the olive oil over high heat until golden, then set aside.
Warm the vegetable stock in a saucepan. Soften the onion and garlic in the rest of the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the carnaroli rice and toast for 2 minutes, then pour in the white wine and stir until it is absorbed.
Add the hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16 minutes until the rice is nearly tender, adding the zucchini for the last 5 minutes.
Stir the mushrooms back in, take off the heat and stir through the butter, the parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve straight away, no cheese.

dishes.make_ahead: Best served straight away; blitz the spinach and basil paste and soak the saffron up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; cook the risotto on the night

steps.text: Heat the chicken stock in a saucepan. Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp of hot water. Blitz the baby spinach and basil leaves with a splash of the stock to a smooth paste.
Soften the onion in 40g of the butter for 5 minutes, add the arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes, then add the white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 17 minutes until the rice is just tender.

Split the risotto into three pans over low heat. Stir the spinach and basil paste into the first, the parmesan and the last 30g butter into the second, and the passata with the saffron and its water into the third.
Spoon the green, white and red risotto side by side on each plate.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead, turn out and reheat sliced

ingredients.item: eggs, boiled and sliced, for the filling

steps.text: Make a dough with the flour and eggs, knead and rest.
Brown the mince with the onion, add the passata and simmer to a ragù.
Roll the dough thin and line an ovenproof bowl greased with the butter.
Toss the cooked ziti with ragù and layer in the bowl with salami, boiled egg and provolone.
Fold the dough over and bake at 180C for 1 hour.
Rest for 30 minutes, turn out and slice.

veg.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead, turn out and reheat sliced

ingredients.item: eggs, boiled and sliced, for the filling

steps.text: Make a dough with the flour and eggs, knead and rest.

Fry the diced eggplant in a third of the olive oil until golden and set aside. Fry the onion and mushrooms in the rest of the oil until browned, add the lentils and passata and simmer to a thick ragù.
Roll the dough thin and line an ovenproof bowl greased with the butter.
Toss the cooked ziti with the ragù and layer in the bowl with the eggplant, boiled egg and provolone.
Fold the dough over and bake at 180C for 1 hour.
Rest for 30 minutes, turn out and slice.

dishes.make_ahead: Season and dry the pork in the fridge the night before

steps.text: Score the skin of the pork belly with a sharp knife. Turn it over and rub the flesh side with the fennel seeds, crushed garlic and chopped rosemary.
Rub the skin with the salt, roll the pork belly up and tie with string every 3cm.
Sit it on a rack and dry uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 240C for 30 minutes until the skin starts to blister.
Turn the oven down to 160C and roast for 2 hours until tender with crisp crackling.
Rest for 15 minutes, cut off the string and carve thick.

veg.n: Big Night whole roast stuffed pumpkin
veg.make_ahead: Stuff and tie the pumpkin up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds and hollow out a little more of the flesh. Score the cut faces.
Mix the fennel seeds, crushed garlic, chopped rosemary, breadcrumbs, grated cheese and half the olive oil and pack into both hollows.
Press the halves back together, tie with string every 5cm and rub the skin with the rest of the oil and the salt.
Roast at 200C for 1 and a half hours until a skewer slides through easily and the skin is blistered.
Rest for 10 minutes, cut off the string and carve into thick rounds.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook just before serving as the eggs turn rubbery; the eggs can be beaten up to 1 hour ahead and kept chilled

steps.text: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, pour in the eggs and stir gently for about 3 minutes until just set underneath and soft on top.
Fold the omelette, slide it onto a plate and cut into four. Serve with the crusty bread torn into pieces.

edition.tagline: One night to save the restaurant.
edition.cue: Bring out the timpano when the dinner party is still waiting on Louis Prima.

s.note: Primo's kitchen, every grain treated with respect
s.how: Cook 300g arborio rice in 900ml stock with a pinch of saffron until thick and chill overnight on a tray. Wrap golf balls of rice around a cube of mozzarella and a few peas, using 100g mozzarella and 50g peas. Roll in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 100g breadcrumbs, and fry at 175C until deep gold.

s.note: the opening course of the big night
s.how: Lay 100g prosciutto flat on a board. Dress 100g bresaola with lemon juice, olive oil and a handful of rocket. Add 150g marinated eggplant, 2 roasted red capsicums peeled and sliced, 150g mixed olives and a warm loaf of Italian bread.

m.note: the giant baked pasta drum, sliced at the table
m.how: Make dough with 300g 00 flour and 3 eggs, roll thin and line a buttered ovenproof bowl. Toss 400g cooked ziti with ragù made from 500g beef mince and 700ml passata. Layer in the bowl with 100g diced salami, 3 boiled eggs and 150g provolone. Fold the dough over, bake at 180C for 1 hour, rest 30 minutes, turn out and slice.

w.note: a sweet finish after the timpano
w.how: Soak 2 gelatine leaves in cold water. Heat 500ml thickened cream, 100ml milk, 80g caster sugar and a split vanilla bean until steaming. Squeeze the gelatine and whisk it in, strain, and pour into four moulds. Set 6 hours. Dip the moulds in hot water, turn out and serve with 250g berries.

d.note: a little grappa, to make you feel better
d.how: Make 4 short espressos with 18g of finely ground coffee each, or brew 200ml very strong stovetop coffee. Pour into 4 small cups. Stir 1 tsp caster sugar into each cup, then add 20ml grappa. Serve each on a saucer with an amaretti biscuit, the way you would finish a long night in the kitchen.
